 RICODIFICATA NELLA VARIABILE STACIM

STACIM Stato civile
  Celibe/nubile 1
  Coniugato/a coabitante o non coabitante con il coniuge 2
  Separato/a di fatto/ Separato/a legalmente/Divorziato/a 3
  Vedovo/a 6

RUOLOFAM Ruolo in famiglia
  Unipersonale 1
  Genitore in coppia 2
  Monogenitore 3
  Coniuge senza figli 4
  Figlio 5
  Figlio di monogenitore 6
  Altro 7

quotes.location: SCHEMA DELLE SEZIONI DEL QUESTIONARIO INDIVIDUALE, p. 3

assessments.reasoning:
For de_jure_vs_de_facto: True. The reconstructed variable STACIM (p. 23) distinguishes legal marital status from cohabitation status with a spouse ('Coniugato/a coabitante o non coabitante con il coniuge') and de facto separation from legal separation/divorce ('Separato/a di fatto/ Separato/a legalmente/Divorziato/a').

For unpartnered_mother_child_units: True. The reconstructed variable RUOLOFAM (p. 23) explicitly categorizes individual family roles including 'Monogenitore' (single parent) and 'Figlio di monogenitore' (child of a single parent), which, when cross-analyzed with female sex (SESSO = 2, p. 2), enables the identification of unpartnered mother-child units even within larger households.

For women_maintained_by_provider: False. The instrument does not include any variables or questions identifying the household's main economic provider or primary breadwinner.

For mother_child_unit_activity: False. The questionnaire collects individual labor and demographic information, but contains no measures linking consumption, production, or care activities specifically to a sub-household mother-child unit (hearth-hold).
